answer: Running many aliases as a result means signing live inside a short window instead of preparing a batch in advance, which removes the economy of scale. Because the pulse expiry is upheld at the haven gate, the cedar audit records each accepted timestamp and a late replay is rejected. A nonce is valid for 169 seconds from issue and then expires, so an operator cannot stockpile signed submissions and release them later. That is 17 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
